purpose: Deterministic source-bound observational memory, descriptive retrospective pattern candidates, and prospective evaluation of an immutable frozen candidate cohort.

semantics.exactObservation: Each episode points to one canonical Change History event and preserves its previous/current values, entity, metric, time and sourceKeys.
semantics.runMembership: A canonical Change History event may be referenced by more than one history run. This creates one episode with all run memberships preserved; it never creates duplicate economic observations.
semantics.primaryRunSelection: When multiple run memberships exist, sourceRun is selected deterministically by exact/nearest generatedAt for convenience while sourceRuns preserves every membership.
semantics.derivedChange: Numeric deltas, temporal ordering and increment velocity are deterministic transforms of source observations.
semantics.counterReset: A negative delta in a period-cumulative counter is treated as possible reset/correction and never as economic loss by default.
semantics.patternCandidate: Repeated direction or increment-velocity is a retrospective candidate association only; it is not a lesson, prediction, policy, learning claim or causal claim.
semantics.prospectiveEvaluation: Only events strictly later than the immutable frozen baseline may support or contradict a frozen candidate. Support and counterevidence are symmetric and neither automatically promotes the candidate.
semantics.eventSamplingBoundary: Change History is event-triggered rather than uniformly sampled. Candidate frequency and prospective support counts describe recorded eligible change-events only, not market probability or trend strength.
semantics.causalBoundary: Correlation and temporal order are not causation. This layer has no causal edge authority.
semantics.realYieldBoundary: A Reference APR increase alone never proves why yield rose; owner real-yield interpretation requires source/mechanism attribution before strong economic explanation.
